annotations.title: S-corp salary and distribution payroll tax comparison

description: Compare self-employment tax as a sole proprietor with FICA on a reasonable S corporation salary plus the extra costs of running an S corporation. Use this tested BusCalc worksheet when the task matches its inputs and scope. Returns named results, units, formula, assumptions, method version, reference-value notes (official figure or your figure, with source and effective date), a check link and a source-page URL. Official reference values are prefilled when omitted; supply every other figure from the user's records. Percent fields take percent numbers. No figures are looked up; no private projects or purchases are accessed. Put tool fields inside inputs. Put tool fields inside inputs. Supply units or modelVersion only when listed in inputSchema. Follow its required fields and exact choices. Do not pass the REST calculator field inside MCP arguments.

base.description: 2026 Social Security wage base (US dollars). Official figure, prefilled from the source named below. Change it only if a newer or different figure applies to you. Official reference value 184500 USD from IRS Topic 751, Social Security and Medicare withholding rates, effective 2026-01-01. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used.

extraPrep.description: Extra accounting and tax-return cost per year (US dollars). Added cost of the corporate return and payroll filings.

medEach.description: Medicare rate, employer and employee each. Percent number: 6.2 means 6.2%. Official figure, prefilled from the source named below. Change it only if a newer or different figure applies to you. Official reference value 1.45% from IRS Topic 751, Social Security and Medicare withholding rates, effective 2026-01-01. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used.

otherPayrollTax.description: Other employer payroll taxes on the salary (your figure) (US dollars). Federal and state unemployment tax and any other employer payroll charges. Example only.

payrollService.description: Payroll service cost per year (US dollars). Software or provider fees for running owner payroll.

profit.description: Business net profit before any owner salary (US dollars). Profit after all other business expenses, for the year.

salary.description: Reasonable salary paid to the owner (your figure) (US dollars). What the business would pay someone else for the owner’s work. Not a figure this calculator supplies.

seFactor.description: Share of net profit subject to SE tax. Percent number: 6.2 means 6.2%. Official figure, prefilled from the source named below. Change it only if a newer or different figure applies to you. Official reference value 92.35% from IRS Form 1040-ES (2026), effective 2026-01-01. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used.

ssEach.description: Social Security rate, employer and employee each. Percent number: 6.2 means 6.2%. Official figure, prefilled from the source named below. Change it only if a newer or different figure applies to you. Official reference value 6.2% from IRS Topic 751, Social Security and Medicare withholding rates, effective 2026-01-01. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used.

stateFees.description: State S corporation fees and taxes per year (US dollars). Franchise tax, annual report fees or entity-level tax for your state.

modelVersion.description: Optional expected method version; a mismatch is rejected.

name: buscalc_s_corp_salary_and_distribution_payroll_tax_comparison

notes.description: Reference-value notes first, then model notes and the standard limit statement.

referenceValues.description: One entry per official reference value in play: the official figure, the figure used, status official or user, source, effective date and the note text.
